reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000480 (the melody read from 000480a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Frederick J. Work's dates (died 1942) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Jerome_Work (c. 1879 - 1942); CCEH's page gives only the year 1907. John W. Work, Jr.'s dates (1871–1925) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Wesley_Work_Jr.; CCEH's page gives only the year 1907. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1907, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000480a.nwc).
